clans.title: Liberia clan boundaries
clans.description: LISGIS 2022 clan boundaries (902) with names and codes, simplified for the web.

counties.title: Liberia county boundaries
counties.description: LISGIS 2022 county boundaries (15), simplified for the web.

county_watch.title: County hazard watch
county_watch.description: Dryness level per county from FAO's Agricultural Stress Index (Warning at 25%+ of cropland stressed, Watch at 10–25%); flood and heat levels are Claude's reading of NOAA/FEWS NET and AGRHYMET bulletins.

district_pop.title: District population
district_pop.description: LISGIS 2022 Population and Housing Census by district (160): people, men, women and households, with area in km².

districts.title: Liberia district boundaries
districts.description: LISGIS 2022 district boundaries (160) with codes, simplified for the web; they match the 2022 census district tables.

enso_status.title: NOAA ENSO status
enso_status.description: ENSO alert status, synopsis and dates from CPC's latest monthly ENSO Diagnostic Discussion, with the latest RONI season and weekly reading dates.

fao_asi_annual.title: FAO seasonal drought stress since 1984
fao_asi_annual.description: Seasonal Agricultural Stress Index per county (and ALL for Liberia) for each year since 1984, from FAO ASIS annual summaries.

fao_county.title: FAO drought indicators by county
fao_county.description: Latest FAO ASIS Agricultural Stress Index, Vegetation Health Index and satellite rainfall (since 1 March and last 30 days, vs long-term average) for each county.

fao_map.title: FAO crop stress map (1 km)
fao_map.description: FAO ASIS Agricultural Stress Index for Liberia's cropland at 1 km, last 12 ten-day periods, plus Historic Agricultural Drought Frequency (1984–2025), as images built from FAO's map service.

fao_map_areas.title: Crop stress by county, district and clan (estimated)
fao_map_areas.description: Estimated from FAO's 1 km map for the latest 10 days: cropland in season, share stressed (25%+ class), average stress class, and drought frequency since 1984, per LISGIS county, district and clan.

fao_rain.title: FAO rainfall every 10 days, 2026
fao_rain.description: Satellite rainfall estimate per county for each 10-day period of the current year, with the long-term average, from FAO ASIS.

liberia_hazards.title: Liberia hazard bulletins
liberia_hazards.description: Bulletins naming Liberia from NOAA CPC / FEWS NET Africa and Global Weather Hazards (Oct–Nov 2026) and AGRHYMET's July 2026 seasonal update, summarised by Claude.

nino_monthly.title: Monthly Niño anomalies this year
nino_monthly.description: Monthly Niño 1+2, 3, 3.4 and 4 anomalies this year (OISST, 1991–2020 base), from CPC's sstoi.indices.

nino_regions.title: Weekly Niño region anomalies
nino_regions.description: Latest weekly sea-surface temperature anomaly per Niño region (OISST v2.1, 1991–2020 base), from CPC's wksst9120.for.

ocean_pacific.title: Ocean warmth, Pacific to Gulf of Guinea
ocean_pacific.description: Last 30 days of NASA GHRSST MUR sea-surface temperature anomaly images (120°E–20°E, 25°S–25°N) with a 1° grid of values decoded from NASA's colour table.

ocean_wafrica.title: Ocean warmth, Liberia and Gulf of Guinea
ocean_wafrica.description: Last 30 days of NASA GHRSST MUR sea-surface temperature anomaly images (25°W–15°E, 5°S–20°N) with a 0.25° grid of values decoded from NASA's colour table.

outlook.title: NOAA official ENSO outlook
outlook.description: Chance of El Niño, neutral and La Niña, and of strong and very strong El Niño, for the next nine 3-month seasons, from CPC's official probability and strength tables.

rain_wafrica.title: Rainfall, Liberia and Gulf of Guinea
rain_wafrica.description: Last 30 days of NASA GPM IMERG daily precipitation-rate images (25°W–15°E, 5°S–20°N) with a 0.25° grid of values decoded from NASA's colour table.

roni.title: RONI by season: 1997, 2015, 2023, 2026
roni.description: NOAA CPC Relative Oceanic Niño Index (ERSST.v6) by 3-month season, from CPC's RONI.ascii.txt.

wind_zones.title: Average wind by county, district and clan
wind_zones.description: Global Wind Atlas 3 mean wind speed and power density at 10, 50 and 100 m, averaged over each LISGIS 2022 county, district and clan.

windstorm_event_counties.title: Windstorm events by county
windstorm_event_counties.description: Each recorded windstorm event split by county, with the county figures and district each source gives.

windstorm_events.title: Windstorm events
windstorm_events.description: Damaging windstorms in Liberia since 2024, compiled by Claude from NDMA (via allAfrica), IFRC DREF MDRLR010 and news reports; a partial record.

flood_map.title: River flood zones map
flood_map.description: JRC Copernicus Global River Flood Hazard Maps v2.1, flood depth classes for 1-in-10, 100 and 500-year floods, Liberia.

flood_areas.title: People and land in the flood zone
flood_areas.description: Area and people (2022 census by district and clan; WorldPop 2025 places them inside or outside the zone) in the 1-in-10, 100 and 500-year river flood zones for every county, district and clan, with flood exposure level.

clan_pop.title: Clan population
clan_pop.description: LISGIS 2022 Population and Housing Census by clan (902 clans): people, men, women, households and density, matched to the 2022 clan map by code.

faq.title: El Niño assistant: approved answers
faq.description: Questions and answers the El Niño assistant draws on (draft, pending EPA review).
